---
name: Request a form
about: Ask for a new form template or category in the library.
title: "[Form Request]: "
---

## What workflow are you trying to support?

Describe the real-world process this form should help with.

## Proposed form name

What should this template be called?

## Category

Which category should it live in? If you are not sure, suggest the closest match.

## Intended audience

Who will fill out this form and who will review the responses?

## Required questions or sections

List the must-have fields, sections, or question types.

## Optional questions or sections

List anything that would be helpful but is not required.

## Output or integration needs

Describe any export, reporting, webhook, or review workflow requirements.

## Compliance, privacy, or wording constraints

Call out any legal, consent, accessibility, or organization-specific wording that matters.

## Example references

Share sample forms, screenshots, links, or notes that would help shape the request.
